title: Agent Control Center + Farm Workbench Stabilization
status: Production code deployed through GitHub/Vercel; Supabase intelligence services active
summary: Converted Agent Control into a standalone realtor workspace, repaired the map-farm startup failure, added official NJ address/town autocomplete, preserved saved-farm context across Map/Database/Reports, and expanded farming/reporting into proprietary Watchdog intelligence workflows.

items.detail: Sidebar launches a standalone Agent Control Center window with Opportunity Desk, Farm Map, Growth and Advanced Farm navigation.
Fixed map JavaScript startup failure; address/town lookup now uses the NJ Office of GIS statewide geocoder with autocomplete and standardized matches.
Town, county, ZIP and radius inputs now autocomplete/normalize through the same NJ geocoder before preview/save.
Returning from Farm Database to Map preserves the saved list ID, polygon and Report Studio target.
Bulk hydration refreshes parcel rows and Watchdog metrics; print remains curated while CSV can carry all selected data points.
Farm Builder and Map support proprietary score/tax-pressure/holding-period/building-age filters through farm-intelligence-scan.
Next major integration layer: HubSpot first, then BoldTrail/kvCORE/Follow Up Boss adapters, field mapping, farm sync, match history and automation.
